markup and its // Webflow styling, while the rows and numbers both come from the CMS — adding a // PTU model is one switch, with nothing to type. // // The TPM figures are the SAME derived values the Model dropdown uses, so the // table cannot drift from the calculator. // // Queried from `document`, not `root` — the table sits above the calculator, // outside [data-ptu="root"]. function buildComputeTable() { var tpl = document.querySelector('[data-ptu-row="template"]'); if (!tpl) return; var container = tpl.parentNode; if (!container) return; container.removeChild(tpl); // detached, still clonable Object.keys(MODELS).forEach(function (key) { var m = MODELS[key]; var row = tpl.cloneNode(true); row.setAttribute('data-ptu-row', 'item'); row.setAttribute('data-key', key); // Writes into the INNERMOST wrapper, not the tagged element itself. // Setting textContent on a
that contains

would // delete that

and its classes — so descend while there's exactly one // child element. Works whether data-ptu-cell sits on the

or the

. function set(name, value) { var cell = row.querySelector('[data-ptu-cell="' + name + '"]'); if (!cell) return; var target = cell; while (target.children.length === 1 && target.firstElementChild) { target = target.firstElementChild; } target.textContent = value; } set('name', m.label); set('input', fmtSpaced(m.input)); set('cached', fmtSpaced(m.cached)); set('output', fmtSpaced(m.output)); set('rate', '$' + m.rate.toFixed(2)); container.appendChild(row); }); } // ---- Calculations ------------------------------------------------------- function ptusFor(rates, inTPM, outTPM, cache) { var demand = (inTPM * cache) / rates.cached + (inTPM * (1 - cache)) / rates.input + outTPM / rates.output; return demand > 0 ? Math.ceil(demand) : 0; } function commMonthly(comm, inTPM, outTPM, cache) { var inTok = inTPM * MIN_PER_MONTH; var outTok = outTPM * MIN_PER_MONTH; return ((inTok * cache) / 1e6) * comm.cached + ((inTok * (1 - cache)) / 1e6) * comm.input + (outTok / 1e6) * comm.output; } function recalc() { var rates = MODELS[modelSel.value]; var comm = COMMERCIAL[compareSel.value]; if (!rates || !comm) return; // Floor at 0. BOUNDS enforces the real minimum on blur, but a negative typed // live would flow through: ptusFor() returns 0 for negative demand (so PTU cost // reads $0) while commMonthly() has no such guard and returns a negative // comparison cost — surfacing as a large negative "savings". var rps = Math.max(0, Number(rpsEl.value) || 0); var inTok = Math.max(0, Number(inTokEl.value) || 0); var outTok = Math.max(0, Number(outTokEl.value) || 0); var cache = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (Number(cacheEl.value) || 0) / 100)); // Převod na TPM var inTPM = rps * 60 * inTok; var outTPM = rps * 60 * outTok; var ptu = ptusFor(rates, inTPM, outTPM, cache); var ptuMonthly = ptu * RATE * MIN_PER_MONTH; resultEl.textContent = fmtSpaced(ptu); costEl.textContent = fmtMoney(ptuMonthly); var commCost = commMonthly(comm, inTPM, outTPM, cache); var saving = commCost - ptuMonthly; var pct = commCost > 0 ? (saving / commCost) * 100 : 0; // savings hodnota ($) if (saveEl.firstChild && saveEl.firstChild.nodeType === 3) { saveEl.firstChild.textContent = fmtMoney(saving); } else { saveEl.textContent = fmtMoney(saving); } saveEl.style.color = 'var(--brand--brand-orange, #FC4C02)'; // savings pct (86% LOWER) if (savePctEl) { savePctEl.textContent = pct >= 0 ? Math.round(pct) + '% LOWER' : Math.round(-pct) + '% HIGHER'; savePctEl.style.color = '#C33800'; } } [modelSel, compareSel, rpsEl, cacheEl, inTokEl, outTokEl].forEach(function (el) { el.addEventListener('input', recalc); el.addEventListener('change', recalc); }); buildComputeTable(); recalc(); } // Wait for the full document. The hidden Collection Lists are page-level markup // and may sit AFTER this embed — running at parse time would find nothing. if (document.readyState === 'loading') { document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init); } else { init(); } })();
